annotations.title: Open tenders in the same field

description: The tenders with an open proposal period published in the last 7 days, in the state (UF) and in the CNAEs of the companies that supply the same as this procurement, highest value first, and the alert body that delivers them (for `create_alert`). Useful when the procurement you looked up is already closed. Free. Without a CNAE, it uses the terms of the object. It is the same read as the alert preview (`POST /api/alertas/previa`), and `alerta` has the body that creates this alert in `POST /api/alertas` (add the `canal`). The result is per field and state and is kept for 30 minutes; when the service is busy or the origin is down, `estado` says so and `itens` is empty.
name: open_tenders_in_field
title: Open tenders in the same field
